title: Wh-questions
point: Put the question word first, then do/does/did or the helper verb, then the subject.

sentences.text: What did you get up to over the weekend?
sentences.note: "Get up to" is the casual way friends ask what someone did.

sentences.ja: 一番近い駅ってどこですか？
sentences.text: Where's the nearest station from here?

sentences.ja: レポートの締め切りっていつだっけ？
sentences.note: "Again" at the end shows you knew once but forgot.

sentences.ja: 誰がこのケーキ持ってきてくれたの？
sentences.note: When "who" is the subject, skip "did": not "Who did bring".

sentences.ja: なんでそんなに早く帰っちゃったの？
sentences.text: Why did you leave so early?

sentences.note: "How's it going" fits ongoing things better than "How is the new job?".

sentences.ja: ここから空港までどれくらいかかりますか？
sentences.text: How long does it take to get to the airport from here?

sentences.ja: どれくらいの頻度でジムに行ってるの？
sentences.text: How often do you go to the gym?

sentences.ja: このジャケット、いくらでした？
sentences.text: How much did you pay for this jacket?

sentences.ja: 教授はどの章を読むようにって言ってた？
sentences.text: Which chapters did the professor tell us to read?
